_note:
SSOT for 'what host version was this repo last checked against'. hosts{} key set is
read live from host-support.json at sweep time, not hand-maintained here (T1) -- this
file's keys mirror that file's keys as of the last time this file was regenerated.
Written only by dependency-sweep.py's apply step, always in the same commit as the
content fixes it reports on (mitigation 2, plan.md Phase 4 step 5). null is the honest
starting state for a never-swept host. version_history is an append-only log of the
DISTINCT versions this host has been swept at (one row per real transition, never one
per run -- a re-confirm with no change does not duplicate the last row), capped at
_VERSION_HISTORY_CAP in dependency-sweep.py. apply's --old-version now defaults to this
file's own last_swept_version for the host when the caller omits the flag, instead of
silently treating an omission as 'no prior version' (mitigation A).
